taskPickup: Read AGENTS.md and the parent Herdr manifest.
Read this manifest, codebase map, artifact registry and upstream source.
Locate the newest same-device `herdr-server-start-*.env` or supply it explicitly.
Validate the exact release identity and prior lifecycle PASS before review or evidence mode.

source-bound-review.gate: must emit BOUNDED_CLIENT_PROTOCOL_OBSERVER_PROBE_APPROVED_NO_INSTALL and keep full-app TUI blocked

same-device-observer.gate: one read-only observer frame, clean stop/exit, no mutation; PASS advances only to bounded-full-tui-attach-review

failureRecovery: On missing/invalid server evidence: stop before download or process launch.
On digest failure: do not chmod/execute the binary.
On server/discovery/observer failure: terminate observer, stop or terminate foreground server, remove sandbox, write sanitized evidence.
Never compensate by running bare `herdr`, creating a workspace, using terminal control/takeover, or changing Android process policy.
KEEP_TMUX remains authoritative after every failure.
handoff: Record exact repo branch/head and stacked base.
Record review/evidence artifact path and proof level.
Record whether cleanup was graceful or forced.
Name the next gate; do not claim full TUI attach from observer proof.
